nodes.title: Render one step from a step signal
nodes.why: The template renders only the active step with @switch (currentStep()), and every navigation flag reads the same signal, so a step change refreshes the OnPush view.
nodes.alternative: Mount every step at once and hide inactive sections with CSS, or keep currentStep as a plain number that only default change detection notices.
nodes.tradeoff: Step DOM is recreated on every move, but the values live in the FormGroup, so nothing typed is lost.

nodes.title: Validate the current group before advancing
nodes.why: Only the active step's controls are surfaced and validated before currentStep can move forward.
nodes.alternative: Advance first and reveal validation errors on the next screen.
nodes.tradeoff: Users must resolve current-step errors before continuing, which protects final form completeness.

nodes.title: Derive the Next button state from group validity
nodes.why: canGoNext reads currentStep() and the signal bridged from the current group's statusChanges, so the Next button's [disabled] binding updates as soon as the step becomes valid; next() keeps its own check as the final guard.
nodes.alternative: Read basicGroup.valid inside the computed, which re-runs only when currentStep changes, or call a method from the template on every check.
nodes.tradeoff: Two toSignal bridges add a few lines, but the button state is a cached value that changes only when validity or the step does.

nodes.title: Validate the full form at submission
nodes.why: Final submission rechecks every nested group and exposes any invalid field before reading the form value.
nodes.alternative: Assume step navigation guarantees validity forever.
nodes.tradeoff: The final validation is redundant in the happy path, but protects against programmatic state changes.
